text:
sophia: Quick follow-up from today's policy editor crit. Played with the idea of a coverage heatmap and a "ghost preview" before you save reorder changes. Wanted to toss the notes here.

morgan: Nice, heatmap = new. What problem are we solving vs the current sim panel?

sophia: two problems: 1) teams can't tell which rules actually see traffic (so they over-optimize). 2) when reordering rules they don't get a sense of how a single request would traverse rules without committing changes.

samir: ghost preview idea sounds cool. Implementation sketch?

sophia: ghost preview = ephemeral path overlay: pick a sample or paste a payload -> highlight rules it would hit (ghosted highlight), show where it stops/falls through. non-destructive, disappears on cancel.

kelly: UX for heatmap: small inline bars next to each rule showing relative hits across samples, plus a per-sample toggle. e.g. tiny sparkline + percent. Also add an eye icon to hide low-traffic rules.

zane: will the heatmap be realtime? worried about noise. could calculate on-demand for the current time window or run a cheap sample.

sophia: agreed — on-demand and cached per-sandbox-run. show a 'last-run' timestamp. default collapsed to save space.

rachel: accessibility notes: heatmap bars need text alternatives. recommend a sr-only string like "rule X: 12% of sampled traffic" and a focusable tooltip with exact counts. Also ensure keyboard can toggle per-sample filters.

morgan: for ghost preview, also include an aria-live announcement when you start the preview: "Preview started for sample signup_flow. 3 rules highlighted." polite. then provide a button labelled "Apply reorder" and "Dismiss preview".

samir: for reorders while preview active, do we animate the ghost highlights to the new positions? could be confusing. Best to freeze preview until user explicitly re-runs it or clicks "refresh preview".

sophia: yeah freeze is simpler. Add a small yellow badge "preview stale" when list has unsaved changes.

kelly: copy thought for validation messages: current: "selector conflict at line 3". alternatives: friendly: "Overlap found with earlier rule — preview the conflict" terse: "Conflicts with rule 'block-spam'" SR-only: "Conflict detected. Use Preview to inspect." Keep short and actionable.

rachel: contrast nit: heatmap color scale 2 vs bg currently ~2.8:1. Need to ensure any text overlay meets 4.5:1. For the bars we can rely on ARIA labels but visible numeric labels must meet contrast. I'll propose a dark slat behind the percent.

zane: performance note: compute heatmap as an aggregated delta of counts per rule per sample. Do it server-side in sandbox and return compressed histogram. client renders sparklines. cheap and robust.

sophia: sandbox-run snapshot from designbot @2177777777:
```
summary: samples=5, rules=12, heatmap_present=true
sample_keys: [signup_flow, api_ingest, batch_job, webhook, cron]
example_top: signup_flow -> send-welcome(8), block-spam(3)
```

morgan: small UI idea: sticky group headers for rules so grouped rules (e.g., auth, spam, routing) don't get lost when scrolling the sim. also a mini-legend showing which group has most conflicts.

kelly: when user clicks a conflict in the preview, jump to the conflicting rule and highlight a brief diff view that shows the overlapping conditions (not full JSON). One-line diffs prefixed with +/- where relevant.

rachel: SR behavior for diffs: announce "Opening conflict diff between 'send-welcome' and 'block-spam'" and set focus to the diff container. Good to include a keyboard shortcut to close diffs (Escape).

samir: implementation checklist: - server-side heatmap endpoint, TTL cache - preview mode that's read-only, toggled run/refresh - mark preview stale on edits - keyboard and aria announcements - diff overlay with sr-focus trap

zane: i'll prototype the heatmap API and return tiny histograms. will coordinate with infra for sandbox compute quota.

sophia: design follow-ups: I'll add two exploration frames in figma: overlay heatmap variant and inline-sparklines variant. also mock the ghost preview UI and the "preview stale" badge.

morgan: can we add a small test case to our UX checklist: "Preview shows correct path for sample X" and "Preview stale badge appears after unsaved reorder"? add to QA.
\kelly: will draft the microcopy strings and SR-only labels and post PR. leaning toward friendly tone with short action verbs.

sophia: thanks team 389 will drop figma links and a short user-story doc. planning to ship as an "editor helpers" phase next sprint if infra agrees.
